note: Which weapon classes a held item satisfies, for a card's 'Weapon: Any ... weapon' line. A class is true (satisfies), false (known not to), or absent (unknown - the card is NOT withheld on an unknown). Keys are the item resource's basename where the corpus has confirmed it, else the wiki title; both join through Pack.key.

sources.corpus: thrown with this item alone in the weapon hand: the server refuses a card the weapon cannot throw, so a throw proves the class. Counts from data/combat/pool 2026-09-17, schema >= 2.
sources.wiki: stated on the item's wiki page (tools/combat-fixtures)
sources.intuition: no statement and no throw; judged from the item's kind (a sword is pointed and edged, a knife is not heavy). Only ever used to say 'no' where the kind makes it plain, or 'yes' where every sibling of that kind is confirmed.
